meta.author:
詞曲：Matt Crocker, Joel Houston, Scott Ligertwood, Reuben Morgan & Marty Sampson
中譯：Ewen Chow, James Liew, Victor Xue, Renee Deng, Grace Ho, Katy Chiu, Kenelm Chan & Daniel Chieng

lines.a: 救恩 撕裂黑夜的沉寂
lines.b: Salvation, tearing through the dead of night

lines.a: 看見神的國 在光速中迸發出色彩
lines.b: See the kingdom burst into colour at the speed of light

lines.a: 自由 改變屬靈的空氣
當明光照耀 幽暗逝去 就不再環繞
lines.b: As the shadows fade into nothing as the day appears

lines.a: 從那高天之上 愛為我們降下
lines.b: Beyond the skies above, love reaching out for us

lines.a: 永活永在君王 耶穌我神
lines.b: The Everlasting One, Jesus our God
Oh we look to the Son
Set our eyes on our Saviour
Oh we look to the Son
Oh we look to the Son

lines.a: 受造物 神的國就要臨到
lines.b: Creation, waking up to kingdom come

lines.a: 看天國盼望像初昇的太陽閃亮
lines.b: See the hope of heaven shining like the rising sun

lines.a: 現在永遠 從死亡中得釋放
lines.b: Now forever, lifted up from death to life

lines.a: 愛一無所懼 勝過黑暗祂彰顯真光
lines.b: There's no fear in love and no darkness in His endless light
